title: precheck warns of a goal that lengthens a cache's reuse when no check varies the cached record's inputs
goal: Retrospective of SP-etslk6yu: ST-jqwqdj2g lengthened the lookup cache's reuse to a source's freshness lifetime, but its check replayed identical printed lines, so it passed while the review found the cache keeps only the last question's lines (BG-iw3p4sw4, S2). The kb-sprint plan rule (an item that adds or widens a cache carries a check that changing each input gives a fresh value) was not applied. backlog.py precheck SP warns of a committed item whose goal reuses, caches or lengthens a stored result and whose checks name no input-variation test; a test runs precheck on a planted sprint and finds the warning.

run:
import sys, os, json, tempfile, types, io, contextlib, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base, bl_land
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', d], check=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog'))
def put(it):
    open(os.path.join(d, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog', it['id'] + '.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(it))
bad = [dict(run=['python3', '-c', 'import sys; sys.exit(1)'])]
put(dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa', kind='sprint', title='planted sprint', status='planned', goal='planted'))
def story(i, goal):
    put(dict(id=i, kind='story', title='planted ' + i, status='draft', priority='P3', sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa', goal=goal, checks=bad))
story('ST-bbbbbbbb', 'The lookup cache reuses its stored result for the freshness lifetime of a source, not for one hour')
story('ST-cccccccc', 'The report prints the item title in its first column')
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    bl_land.cmd_precheck(bl_base.Backlog(d), types.SimpleNamespace(sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa'))
out = buf.getvalue()
print(out)
warn = [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith('warning')]
sys.exit(0 if any('ST-bbbbbbbb' in w for w in warn) and not any('ST-cccccccc' in w for w in warn) else 1)
